RIGHTS: register row HEXACO-PI-R (block, irw#1945) does not apply -- a name lead, not this instrument. Applied the existing IPIP register verdict (ship), same basis as hexaco_ashton_2014_a/_c/_e/_h: ipip.ori.org home page (fetched 2026-09-24 by batch_349, sha256 45d41652bdf7a434973b8501051272e2e8b764f588629fed96f22116d184cd0e): 'The items and scales are in the public domain, which means that one can copy, edit, translate, or use them for any purpose without asking permission and without paying a fee.' No new register row written. TEXT: item_text is the codebook sentence verbatim including its 'I ' prefix; all 40 read grammatically. Two character-level deviations from the IPIP key, kept as the codebook prints them: OAesA4 'I enjoy feeling close to the earth.' (IPIP: 'Enjoy feeling "close to the earth."') and OUnco7 'I enjoy being thought of as a normal mainstream person.' (IPIP: 'normal "mainstream" person'). ANCHORS: codebook header '1 = strongly disagree, 2 = disagree, 3 = slightly disagree, 4 = neutral, 5 = slightly disagree, 6 = agree, 7 = strongly agree'; 5 is an evident typo (duplicates 3 on a symmetric 7-point scale) and ships CORRECTED as 'slightly agree', same as the four siblings; not confirmable against the original form (openpsychometrics.org/tests/HEXACO/ 404s per batch_349). Lowercase as printed. instructions blank: the codebook's lead sentence describes the rating scale for data users, not participant instructions. One trivial section_id. Raw 0 recoded to NA by the script; 15 NA rows of 911,440 in the live table; every item has 22,786 rows and uses all seven levels 1-7.
